org_ref.name: Mastercard Foundation
org_ref.mission: The Mastercard Foundation seeks a world where everyone has the opportunity to learn and prosper. Its mission is to advance education and financial inclusion for financially disadvantaged persons and communities, enabling access to dignified and fulfilling work.
org_ref.description: The Mastercard Foundation is a registered Canadian charity and one of the largest foundations globally. It partners with organizations to enable young people in Africa and Indigenous youth in Canada to access dignified, meaningful, and fulfilling work through education and financial inclusion.

job_ref.title: Program Coordinator – 1 Year Contract
job_ref.summary_ref: This Program Coordinator role supports the development, delivery, and administration of grant programs, including the Journalism Futures Fund, for a public foundation focused on building an inclusive and pluralist Canada.
